caption_L2L3: Olivia is the most registered baby girl name, followed by Amelia. All of the top 10 most registered baby girl names end in a vowel, with y acting as a vowel in 2 of the names. The most registered name (Olivia) is almost twice as popular with nearly 4,000 registrations as compared to the 10th most registered name (Emily) with just over 2,000 registrations. In addition to all 10 of the top 10 most registered names ending with a vowel, more than half of the names begin with a vowel as well, a total of 6.
